name: Anhui Shiny Electronic Technology Company Limited
summary: Anhui Shiny Electronic Technology Limited is a Chinese enterprise that focuses on the innovation, design, manufacturing, and distribution of precision-engineered structural parts and associated molds, primarily for the consumer electronics market. The company's diverse range of products includes stamped components, various metal structural elements, specialized tooling, miscellaneous hardware, injection-molded plastic items, and other plastic goods, often incorporating surface finishing techniques such as spraying. These components are predominantly integrated into the production of laptop computers. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Luan, China.
